In the foreground, a white rectangular bathtub filled with foamy bubbles is visible. The women are dressed in casual summer attire: one in an orange top and patterned jeans, the center one in a white halter top and wide-leg light-blue jeans, and the third in a blue bikini top and white shorts. They begin a choreographed dance, smiling and moving their arms in sync. (2) The center and left women transition into a headstand pose on the wooden floor deck next to the tub, while the third woman stands to the side, cheering and gesturing with excitement. They successfully balance on their heads with their legs bent in the air. (3) After holding the pose, they descend back to the floor. The center woman curls into a ball laughing, while the others clap and celebrate the successful stunt. The lighting is bright and natural from the large window.
